'''Girr Antoc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] diplomat of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was visiting the [[Voss-Ka]] city on [[Voss]], where he was approached by an Imperial, who claimed to be willing to defect to the Republic. In reality, the Imperial was acting on the orders of agent [[Feyenn]] and the only reason for his conversation with Antoc was to secretly record his voice samples.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Girr Antoc appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Speaking to the Enemy" on Voss.
